details.description: Code Llama 7B is the smallest base model in Meta's Code Llama family, an auto-regressive transformer built on Llama 2 and further trained on code and code-related natural language collected between January and July 2023. It performs raw code completion and infilling rather than instruction following. Meta's Code Llama GitHub repository was archived (read-only) on July 1, 2025, and Code Llama is absent from Meta's current model documentation, which now centers on newer Llama releases.
advantages: Scores 33.5% pass@1 on HumanEval and 41.4% pass@1 on MBPP (Meta's Code Llama paper, Table 2).
Supports code infilling (fill-in-the-middle) at the 7B size, per Meta's launch post.
Trained on sequences of up to 16k tokens.
disadvantages: Trained only on data collected through July 2023.
Testing focused on English; use in other languages is out of scope per Meta's model card.
Base model, not instruction- or chat-tuned; it continues text rather than following chat prompts.
Meta's Code Llama GitHub repository was archived in July 2025 and the family is absent from Meta's current model documentation.
use_cases: General code synthesis and understanding across common programming languages.
Base model for further fine-tuning on code tasks.
